import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 (用户指定) START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 HEADLESS = True # 是否无头模式 TIMEOUT = 30000 # 请求超时时间(ms) # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): """确保目录存在""" if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径图片/链接转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style", "iframe"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """解析日期字符串为 YYYY-MM-DD 格式""" if not date_str: return None # 清理空白字符 date_str = date_str.strip() # 尝试匹配 YYYY/MM/DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD match = re.search(r'(\d{4})[-/年](\d{1,2})[-/月](\d{1,2})', date_str) if match: y, m, d = match.groups() return f"{y}-{m.zfill(2)}-{d.zfill(2)}" return None def extract_content(page_content, url): """ 从详情页HTML中提取正文内容 策略：优先查找常见正文容器，如果没有则使用启发式算法 """ soup = BeautifulSoup(page_content, 'html.parser') # 移除干扰元素 for tag in soup(['script', 'style', 'nav', 'header', 'footer', '.footer', '.header', '#topTip']): tag.decompose() # 1. 尝试常见的新闻正文选择器 (根据经验和国内政府网站特点) candidates = [ '#zoom', '.TRS_Editor', '.article-content', '.content', '.news_content', '.detail_content', '.view_content', '.marketRight', '.rightContentBox' # 针对该网站可能的结构 ] content_html = "" for selector in candidates: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element and len(element.get_text().strip()) > 50: # 确保内容长度足够 # 再次清理内部可能的干扰 for ignore in element.select('.pageBox, .close_btn, .print_btn'): ignore.decompose() content_html = str(element) break # 2. 如果没找到，使用启发式算法：找包含

标签最多的 div if not content_html: divs = soup.find_all('div') max_p_count = 0 best_div = None for div in divs: p_count = len(div.find_all('p')) # 排除链接列表页 if p_count > max_p_count and len(div.find_all('a')) < p_count: max_p_count = p_count best_div = div if best_div: content_html = str(best_div) return clean_html_content(content_html, url) # ================= 爬虫主逻辑 ================= def crawl_news(): ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) articles = [] # 启动 Playwright with sync_playwright() as p: # 配置浏览器反爬 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=HEADLESS, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() current_url = TARGET_URL has_next_page = True page_num = 1 print(f"开始爬取，目标时间范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") while has_next_page: print(f"正在处理第 {page_num} 页: {current_url}") try: page.goto(current_url, timeout=TIMEOUT, wait_until="domcontentloaded") page.wait_for_selector(".rightListContent", timeout=10000) except Exception as e: print(f"页面加载失败: {e}") break # 获取列表项 # 根据页面结构分析：div.rightListContent 包含 span.rightListImport.unlock > a 和 span.rightListTime list_items = page.query_selector_all(".rightListContent") if not list_items: print("未找到列表项，结束爬取") break page_articles = [] stop_crawling = False # 标志位：如果遇到日期早于开始日期，且列表按时间倒序，则停止 for item in list_items: try: # 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.query_selector(".rightListImport a") if not link_el: continue title = link_el.inner_text().strip() relative_link = link_el.get_attribute("href") full_link = urljoin(current_url, relative_link) # 提取日期 date_el = item.query_selector(".rightListTime") date_text = date_el.inner_text().strip() if date_el else "" pub_date = parse_date(date_text) print(f"扫描: {pub_date} | {title}") if not pub_date: print(" -> 日期解析失败，跳过") continue # 日期过滤逻辑 if pub_date > END_DATE: print(" -> 日期超出范围(过新)，跳过") continue if pub_date < START_DATE: print(" -> 日期超出范围(过旧)，停止本页及后续爬取") stop_crawling = True break # 假设列表是按时间倒序的 # 符合条件，抓取详情 print(f" -> [命中] 正在抓取详情...") # 打开新页面抓取详情 detail_page = context.new_page() try: detail_page.goto(full_link, timeout=TIMEOUT, wait_until="domcontentloaded") # 稍微等待内容渲染 detail_page.wait_for_timeout(1000) content_html = detail_page.content() # 提取正文 content = extract_content(content_html, full_link) # 提取摘要 (前200字) soup_text = BeautifulSoup(content, 'html.parser').get_text().strip() summary = soup_text[:200] + "..." if len(soup_text) > 200 else soup_text article_data = { "id": str(hash(full_link)), "title": title, "date": pub_date, "source": "中国债券信息网", "author": "", # 详情页可能包含作者，此处暂空 "sourceUrl": full_link, "summary": summary, "content": content } articles.append(article_data) page_articles.append(article_data) # 随机延时 time.sleep(1) except Exception as e: print(f" -> 详情页抓取失败: {e}") finally: detail_page.close() except Exception as e: print(f"处理列表项出错: {e}") continue # 检查是否需要翻页 if stop_crawling: print("已达到结束日期，停止爬取。") break # 查找下一页 # 策略：查找包含 "下一页" 文本的链接，或者 class 为 pageNext 的元素 # 根据HTML分析：，可能没有href，需要点击或查找规律 next_btn = page.query_selector("a.pageNext") # 检查是否有下一页链接 next_href = None if next_btn: next_href = next_btn.get_attribute("href") if next_href and "javascript" not in next_href and next_href != "#": # 静态链接翻页 current_url = urljoin(current_url, next_href) page_num += 1 time.sleep(2) else: # 尝试点击翻页 (如果是JS驱动) # 检查是否是最后一页（通常最后一页的下一页按钮会隐藏或变灰） # 这里简单判断：如果找不到 next_btn 或者 next_btn 不可见，则结束 if next_btn and next_btn.is_visible(): print("尝试点击下一页...") try: with page.expect_navigation(timeout=10000): next_btn.click() current_url = page.url page_num += 1 time.sleep(2) except Exception as e: print(f"翻页失败或已是最后一页: {e}") has_next_page = False else: print("没有下一页了。") has_next_page = False browser.close() return articles def save_results(articles: list, output_path: str): """保存结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"成功保存 {len(articles)} 条数据到: {output_path}") except Exception as e: print(f"保存文件失败: {e}") def main(): print("=== 中国债券信息网新闻爬虫启动 ===") # 生成文件名 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) try: articles = crawl_news() if articles: save_results(articles, output_path) else: print("未抓取到符合条件的数据。") # 即使为空也保存一个空文件结构，方便调用方确认 save_results([], output_path) except Exception as e: print(f"爬虫运行发生严重错误: {e}") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
